organism_provides: exact campaign-session generation and pause validator
typed attempt, authority, lease, verifier, and pre-effect recovery state
async mobile operator-control authority callback and runtime composition
dharmagraph_provides: atomic exact AgentPool reserve and release CAS
exact principal routing with no campaign fallback
provider-boundary fence and readiness handshake before control-gate release
cross_packet_interface.shared_proof: an exact campaign owner reaches its provider only while the captured session generation remains running, and queued work cannot cross a durable pause

interface_mismatches: Bootstrap seed readiness remains immutable false/authority_unbound provenance; runtime readiness comes only from the typed current authority envelope and exact lease.
Agent IDs are boot-local while roster names are stable, so every boot must resolve exactly one live seat and rebind a fresh generation without accepting foreign partial state.

TaskBoard, RuntimeStateStore, file leases, and external oracle custody are separate durability domains; recovery may advance only from exact pre-provider evidence and must preserve prior terminal generations.
The held-out evaluator cannot inherit supervisor filesystem or network authority; core may only publish a canonical request and consume a root-finalized sandbox terminal.
Mobile inbox ACK is transport custody, not campaign authority or effect evidence; the writer callback alone performs the atomic campaign-session transition and durable replay.
Observer health is a pre-dispatch activation condition and never useful-work, verifier, or acceptance evidence.
honest_blockers: Allowed-file policy is governance metadata, not syscall confinement. Write-capable campaign dispatch remains disabled without an actually enforced disposable-workspace sandbox; the admitted production route is read-only/inference-only.
Campaign stop and pause fence new effect starts but cannot revoke an effect that already crossed the final provider boundary; provider cancellation remains a separate invoker concern.
The exact in-process principal thread is a trusted-supervisor boundary, not a hostile-plugin capability membrane.
Missing, malformed, equivocated, or sandbox-unproven held-out evidence remains BLOCKED and is never replaced by model testimony or MemoryFact truth labels.
Exact durable evidence does not by itself prove usefulness, promotion, merge, deployment, publication, or external-world success.
session_entry.rollback: Stop the campaign writer and revert this implementation. Preserve all TaskBoard, RuntimeState, lease, verifier, oracle, and operator-control evidence for audit; remove only unused deterministic lease/request files under separate operational authorization. No provider cancellation, credential mutation, promotion, merge, deployment, or external publication is authorized by rollback.
